outlier_cases.name: The Progressive
outlier_cases.words: The Progressive stays in: it is priced far below the group on 2 of the 3 yardsticks it has (EV/EBITDA 0.54× against the group's 12.2×, EV/sales 0.09× against the group's 2.39×).
